title: Define coordinated upgrade state-transition contract
outcome: A bounded documented state model guides further tests and corrections without replacing existing implementation.
acceptance: A short invariant summary and document link beside the implementation identifies the contract without duplicating its complete table; existing implementation is preserved.
All latest review findings map to contract rows and required tests; Fable consultation is recorded and concrete adjustments resolved; no Cartesian-product coverage claim.

Invariants cover complete preflight, preservation of verified originals, unknown-byte refusal, rollback closure and cleanup ownership; reachable intermediate states are distinguished from corruption and excluded scenarios.
One linked documentation table defines initial state, guards, allowed command, effects, next state and interrupted recovery; contradictory states specify refusal before effects.

completion.summary: Documented and consulted upgrade transition contract with ordered guards, state outcomes, boundary families, finding/test mapping and module link; implementation conformance remains separately owed.
